mar.establishes: That a listed issuer discloses inside information to the public as soon as possible, that it may delay on conditions, and that a credit institution delaying for financial stability needs the authority's consent rather than its notice.

ncsc-nl-mijnncsc.title: MijnNCSC
ncsc-nl-mijnncsc.issuer: Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum · Netherlands · read 3 September 2026
ncsc-nl-mijnncsc.establishes: That the Dutch reporting point is at mijn.ncsc.nl, and that reaching it requires eHerkenning at level EH2+ or Single Sign On Rijk.

digst-haendelsesunderretning.title: Hændelsesunderretning
digst-haendelsesunderretning.establishes: That a Danish notification is submitted through virk.dk, in the self-service of the Styrelsen for Samfundssikkerhed, and reaches the sector-responsible authority and the CSIRT from that one submission.

ncsc-se-incidentrapportering.title: Incidentrapportering enligt cybersäkerhetslagen
ncsc-se-incidentrapportering.establishes: That Swedish incident reports are made through the Incidentrapporteringsverktyget in the Cyberportalen at cyberportal.ncsc.se, that the regulations and the tool both took effect on 1 July 2026, and that the reports are forwarded from there to the supervisory authorities.

traficom-nis2-ilmoitus.title: NIS2-direktiivin mukainen poikkeamailmoitus
traficom-nis2-ilmoitus.issuer: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficom, Kyberturvallisuuskeskus · Finland · read 3 September 2026
traficom-nis2-ilmoitus.establishes: That Finnish notifications are made through a NIS2 reporting application that carries all three stages, and that every notification also reaches the Centre's CSIRT unit.

nis-at-meldungen.title: NIS Meldungen
nis-at-meldungen.issuer: NIS-Behörde, Bundesministerium für Inneres · Austria · read 3 September 2026
nis-at-meldungen.establishes: That Austria has four reporting platforms divided by sector rather than one, and that the authority's page does not distinguish NIS from NIS2 reporting on them.

ria-teavita.title: Teavita küberintsidendist
ria-teavita.issuer: Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet, CERT-EE · Estonia · read 3 September 2026
ria-teavita.establishes: That an Estonian notification is made on a web form at raport.cert.ee, or by plain e-mail to CERT-EE.

ursiv-prijava.title: Prijava incidenta
ursiv-prijava.issuer: Urad Vlade Republike Slovenije za informacijsko varnost · Slovenia · read 3 September 2026
ursiv-prijava.establishes: That Slovenia has no reporting portal in service, and that until the self-registration mechanism works the forms go to the office at gp.uiv@gov.si.

cert-hr-zks-incident.title: Opće smjernice za provedbu obveze obavještavanja o značajnim incidentima
cert-hr-zks-incident.issuer: Nacionalni CERT, CARNET · Croatia · read 3 September 2026
cert-hr-zks-incident.establishes: That Croatian notifications go through the PiXi platform at pixi.carnet.hr, that access is only through the national identification system with authorization granted in advance, and which of the two CSIRTs is competent for which kind of entity.

nki-incidens-bejelentes.title: Incidens bejelentés
nki-incidens-bejelentes.issuer: Nemzeti Kiberbiztonsági Intézet · Hungary · read 3 September 2026
nki-incidens-bejelentes.establishes: That Hungarian notifications reach the National Cyber Security Institute at incidens.nki.gov.hu, by e-mail to CSIRT@nki.gov.hu or by telephone, at any hour.

nsm-varsle.title: Varsle om hendelser etter digitalsikkerhetsloven
nsm-varsle.establishes: That Norway has no reporting portal, that the notification is a published form sent by electronic mail to beredskap@nsm.no, and that it goes to the entity's sector supervisor with the National Security Authority copied.

cert-lv-riciba.title: Rīcība kiberincidenta gadījumā
cert-lv-riciba.establishes: That Latvia has no reporting portal, and that each of the five statutory forms is filled in, signed with a secure electronic signature and sent to cert@cert.lv or cert@cert.gov.lv.

cyber-gov-gr-anafora.title: Αναφορά Συμβάντων
cyber-gov-gr-anafora.issuer: Εθνική Αρχή Κυβερνοασφάλειας · Greece · read 3 September 2026
cyber-gov-gr-anafora.establishes: That Greece has no reporting portal for the NIS2 duty, and that the Authority takes two dated forms by electronic mail at incident@cyber.gov.gr: a simple one for the early warning, an analytical one for the later stages.

ilr-serima.title: SERIMA (SEcurity RIsk MAnagement)
ilr-serima.issuer: Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation · Luxembourg · read 3 September 2026
ilr-serima.establishes: That Luxembourg's notifications go through one portal at serima.lu/notification, that the same portal serves NIS2, the GDPR, the electronic communications regime and CER, and that the notification module needs no prior account.

island-is-tilkynna.title: Tilkynna öryggisatvik til CERT-IS
island-is-tilkynna.establishes: That an Icelandic notification is made on an application form on island.is or at cert@cert.is, and that a mandatory notification under the network and information systems act is forwarded from there to the relevant supervisory authority.

csirt-cy-anafora.title: Αναφορά Περιστατικού
csirt-cy-anafora.establishes: That Cyprus has no reporting portal, and that an incident is reported by sending a completed form to REPORTING@CSIRT.CY or by telephone to 1490.

edpb-9-2022.title: Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR
edpb-9-2022.issuer: European Data Protection Board · European Union · 4 April 2023, version 2.0
edpb-9-2022.establishes: How the EDPB reads the moment of awareness, that a short period of investigation precedes it, and that an unbounded one can be treated as a failure to notify.

edpb-1-2021.title: Guidelines 01/2021 on Examples regarding Personal Data Breach Notification
edpb-1-2021.issuer: European Data Protection Board · European Union · 14 December 2021, version 2.0
edpb-1-2021.establishes: Eighteen worked cases, each with the facts, the risk assessment and the three outcomes, including one where the actor is an employee.

pl-dz-u-2026-252.title: Ustawa z dnia 23 stycznia 2026 r. o zmianie ustawy o krajowym systemie cyberbezpieczeństwa oraz niektórych innych ustaw
pl-dz-u-2026-252.establishes: That Poland's NIS2 amendment was promulgated on 2 March 2026 as poz. 252 and enters into force one month after promulgation by its article 49; that the early warning and the notification of a serious incident run from the moment of its detection, at twenty-four and seventy-two hours; that the final report is owed within a month of the notification; and that all three are owed to the competent sectoral CSIRT.

anssi-nis2-avancement.title: Avancement de la transposition de la directive NIS 2
anssi-nis2-avancement.issuer: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information · France · read 2026-09-04
anssi-nis2-avancement.establishes: That the French transposing bill had passed the Senate on 12 March 2025 and the special committee of the Assemblée nationale on 10 September 2025, and had not been promulgated when the Agency updated the note on 19 September 2025.

dsn-anteproyecto-ciberseguridad.title: El Consejo de Ministros aprueba el anteproyecto de Ley de Coordinación y Gobernanza de la Ciberseguridad
dsn-anteproyecto-ciberseguridad.issuer: Departamento de Seguridad Nacional · Spain · read 2026-09-04
dsn-anteproyecto-ciberseguridad.establishes: That the Council of Ministers approved the draft transposing law on 14 January 2025, and that the draft would make a National Cybersecurity Center the single competent authority. It gives no date for the Cortes and no deadlines.

es-rd-43-2021.title: Real Decreto 43/2021, de 26 de enero, por el que se desarrolla el Real Decreto-ley 12/2018
es-rd-43-2021.issuer: Boletín Oficial del Estado · Spain · read 2026-09-04
es-rd-43-2021.establishes: That under the act transposing the first Directive the CCN-CERT, with INCIBE-CERT and ESPDEF-CERT, runs the Plataforma Nacional de Notificación y Seguimiento de Ciberincidentes (article 11), and that operators of essential services notify through it as soon as they hold the information to determine that an incident is reportable, with intermediate and final notifications set by severity in the annex.

eurlex-nim-nis2.title: National implementing measures notified for Directive (EU) 2022/2555
eurlex-nim-nis2.issuer: Publications Office of the European Union · European Union · read 2026-09-04
eurlex-nim-nis2.establishes: Which national acts each Member State has notified to the Commission as transposing the Directive, with each act's title, official publication and date. For Lithuania, twenty-two measures, among them the law amending the cyber security law, No XIV-2902, published in the Teisės aktų registras as 2024-13535 on 24 July 2024.

sk-nbu-jiskb.title: JISKB, Jednotný informačný systém kybernetickej bezpečnosti
sk-nbu-jiskb.establishes: That the Authority's single cybersecurity information system is at jiskb.nbu.gov.sk, that operators of essential services register, report incidents and communicate with the Authority through it, and that the public reports through SK-CERT instead.

garante-docweb-10235001.title: Provvedimento n. 208 del 26 marzo 2026, notice of removal
garante-docweb-10235001.issuer: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali · Italy · read 2026-09-05
garante-docweb-10235001.establishes: That a sanction decision, n. 208 of 26 March 2026, followed the case this record calibrates T5 on, and that the Authority's site states it was temporarily removed under an interim order of the Tribunale di Torino of 13 July 2026. The decision itself is not read.

uk-gdpr-art-33.title: UK GDPR, article 33, as retained
uk-gdpr-art-33.establishes: That the retained article keeps the Union's duty to notify without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware, owed to the Commissioner, in the version revised to 4 September 2026.

uk-nis-regulations-2018.title: The Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018, regulation 11
uk-nis-regulations-2018.establishes: That an operator of essential services must notify the designated competent authority in writing of an incident with a significant impact on the continuity of the essential service, without undue delay and in any event no later than 72 hours after the operator is aware that a NIS incident has occurred, and that the Regulations came into force on 10 May 2018.

uk-mar-art-17.title: UK MAR, article 17, as retained
uk-mar-art-17.establishes: That the retained article keeps the issuer's duty to inform the public as soon as possible of inside information, the delay on the issuer's own responsibility, and the duty to inform the FCA immediately after disclosure where disclosure was delayed, in the version revised to 3 September 2026.

ch-fadp.title: Federal Act on Data Protection, SR 235.1
ch-fadp.establishes: That under article 24 the controller notifies the FDPIC as quickly as possible of a breach of data security likely to lead to a high risk to the data subject's personality or fundamental rights, and informs the data subject where required for their protection or where the FDPIC so requests. In force 1 September 2023.

ch-isg.title: Informationssicherheitsgesetz, SR 128
ch-isg.establishes: That from 1 April 2025 the operators of critical infrastructure listed in article 74b must report a cyberattack to the BACS within 24 hours of its discovery (article 74e), that article 74d says which attacks must be reported, and that article 74f provides for electronic reporting.
